# Covariate curation

## Covariate selection and curation
Covariates are the data used my machine learning models to make predictions. 


To run random forest models, each point that is fed into the model must have and associated value
for every covariate in the raster stack. All rasters are registered to the same 10 meter grid in
EPSG:5070 before extraction
